from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            top = min(y for y,x in cells); bottom = max(y for y,x in cells)
            left = min(x for y,x in cells); right = max(x for y,x in cells)
            height, width = bottom-top+1, right-left+1
            if height < 3 or width < 3:
                continue
            frame = all(grid[top][x] == color and grid[bottom][x] == color for x in range(left,right+1)) and all(grid[y][left] == color and grid[y][right] == color for y in range(top,bottom+1))
            if frame:
                fill = 2 if height % 2 == 0 and width % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y in range(top+1,bottom):
                    for x in range(left+1,right):
                        if grid[y][x] == background:
                            out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
p=program_dir/'task-e480fa9e.py'
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
print('saved', p)
